tools.name: styx_beacon
tools.description: Ping STYX — return liveness and the current Tor exit identity.

tools.name: styx_order
tools.description: Create a BTCPay invoice for STYX credits (min 100). Returns order_id + checkout_link to pay.

tools.name: styx_collect_key
tools.description: After paying the invoice, collect your API key by order_id.

tools.name: styx_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a URL through the Tor network. Requires a paid STYX key (1 credit).

tools.name: styx_renew
tools.description: Rotate to a fresh Tor circuit/identity (1 credit).

tools.name: styx_credits
tools.description: Check remaining credits on your STYX key.
